caption: The drawing depicts a blue Victorian-style dress with long sleeves, a high collar, and a fitted bodice that fastens down the front with a row of white buttons. The skirt features multiple layers and textures, including a ruched overskirt trimmed with fringe, a lower skirt with alternating solid and patterned blue vertical panels, and additional decorative elements such as bows and tassels. In the upper right corner, there is a rectangular inset showing a line drawing of the same dress from the back, highlighting the seam lines, draping, and back fastening details. The dress illustration is centered on a plain, light background, and “Mary Humes” is written in small text in the lower right margin.
title: Dress
